children: RNS Number : 3127U  AVI Japan Opportunity Trust PLC  10 September 2026
The Company is in a closed period (in accordance with the provisions of the Market Abuse Regulation) in relation to the announcement of the Company's results for the six months ended 30 June 2026.

The Directors of the Company confirm that they are satisfied that all inside information the Directors and the Company may have held up to the date of this notice has been notified to a Regulated Information Service. Accordingly, in the absence of any new undisclosed inside information arising, the Company is not prohibited from dealing in its securities.
MUFG Corporate Governance Limited - Company Secretary
